deepdive.sec: IT Services — Consulting-led, AI-Native Platform Transformation

bull_bear.body:
- **Interim dividend Rs 2/share**; **>$3bn returned to shareholders over the trailing year** (dividends + prior buyback).
- Acquisitions (Mindsprint) + Wipro Ventures ($0.5bn) into AI/data/security startups.
- Disciplined margin focus alongside continued "invest for the future" (AI-native talent/infra).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Weak Q2 guide (−1.5% to +0.5% CC)** and soft demand / longer decision cycles — growth trough not clearly called.
- **Americas softness** (Americas-2 −7.3% YoY) and **Health + EMR declines** — the sector drags.
- **Large-deal TCV down YoY** with decisions slipping — conversion risk.
- **AI cannibalization of the existing book** — SDLC productivity compresses traditional IT/BPO budgets; mgmt argues net-positive via new AI services + "human + AI always," but the transition is a revenue/margin risk.
- **Margin recovery un-timed** amid competitive large-deal pricing + AI-investment drag + token-cost/ToC pressure.
- Integration execution on Mindsprint + acquisition margin drag.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Srini Pallia is measured and consistent — frames AI as a *structural, market-expanding* opportunity ("we have pivoted to AI") while candidly owning the soft quarter, the BFSI QoQ dip (large-deal ramp + slow discretionary), and the Healthcare/US pressure. Disciplined on guidance (one-quarter view only; won't time the margin recovery or forecast sector turns). CFO Aparna Iyer precise on the margin bridge and deal-margin nuance (accretive "Reimagine AI" vs give-backs on cost-take-out deals), and firm on non-disclosure (won't split organic/inorganic guidance). Balanced tone — invests for the future without over-promising the timeline.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- **Guidance is only one quarter out, and it's negative-to-flat** — the demand trough isn't called; H2 hinges on slipped large deals converting and EMR/BFSI-Americas ramps.
- **Ex-Mindsprint, headcount fell 2,500 QoQ** — the reported headcount rise is entirely the acquisition; underlying is still shrinking, consistent with AI-productivity + soft demand.
- **AI is both the risk and the pitch** — mgmt concedes SDLC productivity compresses the traditional book, but argues the offset is "Reimagine AI" (advisory, data priming, agent orchestration, Sovereign AI, AI-DC) at premium realizations; the mix shift is the whole equity story.
- **Margin-band recovery deliberately un-timed** — 16% → 17–17.5% is a "mission," not a dated commitment; levers (pyramid/agentification, bench, G&A) exist but revenue softness gates the pace.
- **Ecosystem breadth is a signal** — CoEs/awards across **both Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI**, plus Wipro Ventures into AI startups, position Wipro as model-agnostic in the "platform + service" future it describes.

bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **BFSI:** +2.6% YoY but −1.2% QoQ — large-deal ramp delays + slower discretionary/decision-making; Europe & APMEA growing, Americas momentum building; **client insourcing headwind now "behind us."** Cost-optimization/vendor-consolidation savings being reinvested by clients into AI.
- **Healthcare (−3.0% YoY):** US payer/provider ecosystem under structural + demographic + government/budget pressure; budgets flattish-to-negative, reallocated toward AI + compliance. Opportunities in claims, contact-center cost take-out, HIPAA-compliant clinical/regulatory AI; Medicare/Medicaid/ACA platform support.
- **EMR (−8.9% YoY):** soft in Europe/APMEA; two European wins to ramp.
- **Tech & Comm (+10.8%):** strongest; double-digit in Americas, momentum to continue.
- **Capco (BFSI consulting):** won AI Governance & Risk Excellence Award at OpenAI Partner Summit; UK AI Lab won OpenAI Codex Hackathon (AI banking solution).
- **Mindsprint:** acquisition closed, integration→execution; deepening Olam Group relationship + food/agri opportunities. Fully in Q2 guidance.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body: - **Domain + client-context depth as the AI differentiator** — mgmt's evidenced thesis: AI success "is not just driven by models" but by client context, domain/process understanding and data priming; Capco's regulated-industry consulting + deep BFSI/Healthcare platforms (Medicare/Medicaid/ACA support) are cited as where Wipro can "prime data" and run compliant AI few peers can. Conviction medium — asserted via award wins + named deals rather than hard share data.
business.title: 6a. Moat & competitive position (OPTIONAL)

latest_quarter.body: Margin fell 120 bps YoY to 16% on: (1) incremental salary-increase (MSI) impact, (2) AI + deal investments, (3) newly-closed acquisitions entering execution — partly offset by INR depreciation + operational efficiencies. Levers to reclaim 17–17.5%: automation/AI/productivity (FPP), G&A, higher bench utilization, pyramid restructuring / "agentifying" existing programs. Deal-margin math is deal-specific: cost-take-out/large traditional deals carry forward-productivity give-backs and competitive pressure; "Reimagine AI" / data / advisory / smaller data-modernization work is rate-accretive and net-positive to realizations. Token economics rising — clients focused on total cost of ownership / ROI (high-end LLM vs open-source), a pricing conversation Wipro leans into via its deep-tech positioning.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this):** IT-services $2.61bn (+0.9% YoY, −1.2% QoQ CC); margin 16% (−120 bps YoY); net income Rs 3,360 cr; bookings $3.4bn (large deals $1.6bn/13). APMEA (+13.5%) & Tech-Comm (+10.8%) strong; Americas-2 (−7.3%), Health (−3.0%), EMR (−8.9%) weak. Mindsprint closed. AI-native unit strategy→execution; Applied AI CoE for Claude/Anthropic; Capco OpenAI award. Q2 guide −1.5% to +0.5% CC. Interim dividend Rs 2; >$3bn returned trailing 1yr. Margin band target 17–17.5% (untimed).
- _Q2 FY27 → check: guidance-range delivery (Mindsprint-inclusive), margin trajectory toward 17%, large-deal-slippage conversion, BFSI-Americas & EMR-Europe ramps, Health stabilization, AI-native unit monetization._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- **Q2 FY27 IT-services revenue: $2.574bn – $2.627bn → sequential −1.5% to +0.5% in constant currency.** Demand "remains soft"; Mindsprint fully consolidated in Q2. Company gives only a one-quarter view.
- **Margin:** mission to return to the **17%–17.5% narrow band** (from 16%) — **no timeframe committed** given revenue/volatility backdrop; multiple levers (automation/AI/productivity, G&A, bench utilization, pyramid restructuring/"agentification").
- **Capital return:** **interim dividend Rs 2/share**; incl. this, **>$3bn returned to shareholders over the trailing 1 year**.
- Wage increases (MSI) now behind (impacted Q1 margin).
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body: Q1 bookings $3.4bn (large deals $1.6bn / 13 deals) — down YoY on timing, with some decisions slipped to Q2 (mgmt pushing to close in M1/M2). Pipeline "healthy" across regions: BFSI strong in Americas + Europe; Tech-&-Comm very strong in Americas (double-digit); EMR recovering in Europe (two wins) + Americas/LATAM; Consumer modest (Americas/Europe) and weak in APMEA; Healthcare pipeline "strong" but mgmt cautious. New opportunity types: Sovereign AI, AI-DC (size depends on design vs implementation scope). Two highlighted wins: a global animal-healthcare provider (digital ops modernization via Wipro Intelligence) and a European specialty-chemicals company (application transformation via WINGS).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **AI-native business & platforms unit** — launched last quarter, now strategy→execution: building AI-powered industry/cross-industry platforms, new AI-native business models, specialized leadership hired.
- **"Reimagine AI" services** — AI advisory & change management (Capco-led), data priming for AI, agent implementation/orchestration/management, ModelOps, Sovereign AI, AI-DC, AI security/responsible AI.
- **Wipro Intelligence / WINGS** — delivery platform gaining traction; future consumption = "platform + service," not pure service.
- **Ecosystem** — Applied AI CoE for **Claude models (Anthropic)**; frontier-AI partnerships; **Wipro Ventures ($0.5bn)** targeting AI/data/security startups; 10 Wipro Innovation Networks for client co-innovation.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: A soft-but-in-line quarter — **IT-services revenue $2.61bn (+0.9% YoY, −1.2% QoQ CC)**, **margin down 120 bps YoY to 16%** on wage hikes + AI/deal investments + acquisition drag, and a **weak Q2 guide of −1.5% to +0.5% CC**. Americas (esp. Americas-2 −7.3% YoY), Health (−3.0%) and EMR (−8.9%) are the drags; APMEA (+13.5%) and Tech-&-Comm (+10.8%) the bright spots. The whole narrative is the **AI pivot**: a new AI-native business unit moving "strategy → execution," the WINGS delivery platform, "Reimagine AI" services (advisory, data priming, agent orchestration, ModelOps, Sovereign AI, AI-DC), and ecosystem CoEs (an **Applied AI CoE for Claude models with Anthropic**; Capco won an OpenAI Partner-Summit award). Management frames AI as market-*expanding*, funds the investment through disciplined margin levers, and targets a return to the **17–17.5%** band (no timeframe) while returning **>$3bn to shareholders** over the trailing year.
